reviews.name: Sara K.
reviews.comment: Ordered this for my daughter's birthday. Rich, moist and not too sweet. Everyone asked where it came from!

reviews.name: Omar H.
reviews.comment: Flaky, buttery and still warm in the morning. Best croissant in town, hands down.

reviews.name: Priya N.
reviews.comment: Lovely frosting and very pretty. I'd love a slightly bigger size, but the taste is spot on.

reviews.name: Daniel R.
reviews.comment: Friendly staff, cosy café and the smell when you walk in is unbeatable. Where smiles are served daily indeed.

reviews.name: Lina M.
reviews.comment: Crispy edges, gooey centre. A bit pricey for a box of six, but worth it.

reviews.name: James T.
reviews.comment: Great crust and flavour. It sold out before noon though, so get there early.
